title: podman run fails with WSL v3.0.1 (rootless with cpu/ram limits)
body:
Path 6.1.4 fixd problem with start rootful container (WSL 3.0.1)

https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29749

But problem does not solve with rootless containers

```shell
PS C:\Users\andrey> wsl --version

Версия ядра: 6.18.40.1-1

podman version 6.1.4

cgroupControllers: []
cgroupManager: cgroupfs
cgroupVersion: v2
[user@OPARIN2-PC ~]$
[user@OPARIN2-PC ~]$
[user@OPARIN2-PC ~]$ podman run --rm --cpus=1 --memory="256mb" hello
Error: crun: open memory.max for writing: No such file or directory: OCI runtime attempted to invoke a command that was not found

on root it works
```
